conservation.usage: 从前述多项原因挑出主要项；which 有明确的复数先行词，后列两项用 are
conservation.example: This problem has several causes, the foremost of which are high rents and low wages.

conservation.phrase: an increasing need for essential items
conservation.usage: need for + N，表达需求增长
conservation.example: An ageing population can create an increasing need for accessible housing.

conservation.phrase: releasing toxic chemicals or pesticides into the waterways
conservation.usage: release + 排放物 + into + 接收环境，交代污染机制
conservation.example: Factories may release harmful gases into the atmosphere.

conservation.phrase: is also being exacerbated by wasteful daily habits
conservation.source: 熟悉（讲义）句型／校正搭配
conservation.usage: be exacerbated by + N/V-ing，已有问题被加剧
conservation.example: Traffic congestion can be exacerbated by unreliable bus services.

conservation.phrase: the sheer size of the population
conservation.usage: the sheer size of + N，规模放大小影响
conservation.example: The sheer size of the student population makes small improvements to school meals significant.

conservation.usage: impose regulations + governing N，明确规定管理对象
conservation.example: Governments could impose regulations governing the collection of personal data.

conservation.usage: impose sanctions on + 受罚主体，交代违规后果
conservation.example: Authorities could impose sanctions on companies that breach safety rules.

conservation.phrase: have given rise to a shortage of drinkable water
conservation.source: 熟悉（讲义）句型／校正宾语
conservation.usage: give rise to + N，指出形成的结果；to 是介词
conservation.example: A shortage of affordable homes can give rise to longer commutes.

restriction.phrase: opinions differ as to how water should be used
restriction.usage: as to + 疑问从句，说明分歧对象；嵌入问句用陈述语序
restriction.example: Opinions differ as to how public transport should be funded.

restriction.phrase: The argument in favour of giving priority to individuals' needs is that
restriction.usage: in favour of + N/V-ing；give priority to + N/V-ing；is that 后完整从句
restriction.example: The argument in favour of giving priority to practical training is that students can develop job-related skills.

restriction.source: 熟悉（讲义）句型／通用补充限定词
restriction.usage: lay claim to + N，主张拥有；exclusive 表示排他
restriction.example: No single department should lay exclusive claim to shared research facilities.

restriction.phrase: highlight the urgent need for governments to impose regulations
restriction.usage: highlight + N；need for sb to do，明确行动主体
restriction.example: This case highlights the urgent need for schools to improve data protection.

restriction.phrase: contribute to the depletion of fresh water
restriction.source: 熟悉（通用搭配库）／熟悉（讲义）名词
restriction.usage: contribute to + N/V-ing；depletion of + 资源，表达促成耗减
restriction.example: Excessive household energy use can contribute to the depletion of finite fuel resources.

restriction.phrase: concern for future generations justifies measures to limit excessive water usage
restriction.usage: concern for + 关切对象；justify + N；measures to do，给出限制的理由
restriction.example: Concern for children's privacy justifies measures to limit unnecessary data collection.

restriction.phrase: providing an incentive to reduce excessive use
restriction.source: 熟悉（讲义）句型／校正语境
restriction.usage: provide an incentive to do；也可 provide an incentive for sb to do
restriction.example: Affordable training can provide an incentive for employees to update their skills.

restriction.phrase: without restricting access to water for basic needs
restriction.source: 熟悉（讲义）access to／通用补充组合
restriction.usage: without + V-ing；access to + N，说明措施应保护的边界
restriction.example: Libraries could reduce operating costs without restricting access to essential learning resources.

eight-te01.usage: 机会成本：time/money that would otherwise be spent on + N/V-ing。
eight-te01.example: Money that would otherwise be spent on printed manuals could fund teacher training.

eight-te01.usage: 承担经常性开销：cover + costs；overhead修饰间接运营成本。
eight-te01.example: Small museums may struggle to cover the overhead costs of maintaining their buildings.

eight-te01.usage: 说明严重负面影响：take a heavy toll on + 人/状态/活动。
eight-te01.example: An excessive exam workload can take a heavy toll on students’ well-being.

eight-te01.usage: 说明沟通方式：communicate + face to face；名词前用face-to-face。
eight-te01.example: Language learners can build confidence when they communicate face to face with visitors.

eight-te01.usage: 建立关系：forge bonds with + 人 / between + 双方。
eight-te01.example: Community sports can help residents forge bonds with their neighbours.

eight-te02.usage: 说明辅助作用：provide a helping hand for + 群体 / in + V-ing。
eight-te02.example: Public libraries are providing a helping hand for adults learning digital skills.

eight-te02.usage: 家务劳动：escape from / spend time on + domestic chores。
eight-te02.example: Shared housing arrangements can help students divide domestic chores fairly.

eight-te02.usage: 限定就业影响：can displace workers in + 行业/岗位。
eight-te02.example: A shift towards online retail can displace workers in traditional shops.

eight-te02.usage: 提升运行效率：boost + efficiency；须说明靠哪一环节。
eight-te02.example: A shared booking system can boost operational efficiency in sports centres.

eight-te02.usage: 给判断附条件：provided that + 完整从句。
eight-te02.example: Tourism can benefit a village, provided that visitor income supports local conservation.

eight-t01.usage: 解释偏好动机：the pursuit of + 抽象目标；不等于收入能力。
eight-t01.example: The pursuit of convenience may encourage shoppers to choose home delivery.

eight-t01.phrase: opting for another affordable mode of transport
eight-t01.usage: 选择替代：opt for + N；opting为与reducing并列的V-ing。
eight-t01.example: Parents may respond to high fees by opting for a community childcare scheme.

eight-t01.usage: 指出可疑前提：be based on the questionable assumption that + 从句。
eight-t01.example: The policy rests on the questionable assumption that every student has a quiet room.

eight-t01.phrase: may be less responsive to fuel prices
eight-t01.usage: 说明较弱反应：be responsive to + N；less不等于完全不反应。
eight-t01.example: Experienced employees may be less responsive to small financial bonuses.

eight-t01.usage: 行为转变：may voluntarily shift from + 起点 + to + 终点。
eight-t01.example: With affordable local facilities, families may voluntarily shift from indoor entertainment to outdoor activities.

eight-t02.usage: 催化变化：act as a catalyst for + N/V-ing。
eight-t02.example: A community festival can act as a catalyst for interest in local history.

eight-t02.usage: 说明认识来源：learn/recognise + 宾语 + through direct experience。
eight-t02.example: Students can understand workplace expectations through direct experience.

eight-t02.phrase: reduces their dependence on private cars
eight-t02.usage: 降低依赖：reduce dependence on + N。
eight-t02.example: Practical cookery lessons may reduce students’ dependence on ready-made meals.

eight-t02.usage: 增加预算分配：increase budget allocation for + N/V-ing；表示目的可另接 to + 动词原形。
eight-t02.example: Increasing budget allocation for mentoring could improve support for new teachers.

eight-t02.usage: 提供成本合理性：help to justify + cost；helping为结果补充。
eight-t02.example: A shared hall can serve both classes and local events, helping to justify its cost.

eight-t03.phrase: give relatively little weight to fares
eight-t03.usage: 说明考虑权重：give little weight to + N；不是完全忽视。
eight-t03.example: Employers may give relatively little weight to grades when applicants have strong practical experience.

eight-t03.phrase: in exchange for comfort and convenience
eight-t03.usage: 交换关系：accept/pay + 成本 + in exchange for + 收益。
eight-t03.example: Some tourists pay higher prices in exchange for more personalised guidance.

eight-t03.phrase: may do little to relieve peak-hour congestion
eight-t03.usage: 限定作用：do little to + V，表示作用小而非完全无效。
eight-t03.example: Extra homework may do little to improve understanding when students receive no feedback.

eight-t03.usage: 增加负担：place pressure on + 承受者；additional修饰pressure。
eight-t03.example: Rising rents can place additional pressure on small cultural organisations.

eight-t03.usage: 成本效益比较：be less cost-effective than + N/V-ing。
eight-t03.example: A universal subsidy may be less cost-effective than targeted support for disadvantaged learners.

eight-f01.usage: 全面禁令：impose a blanket ban on + N/V-ing；范围强，需相称理由。
eight-f01.example: A blanket ban on school trips could deprive pupils of valuable learning experiences.

eight-f01.usage: 资源渠道：restrict + 人’s access to + N。
eight-f01.example: High ticket prices can restrict families’ access to cultural events.

eight-f01.phrase: is grounded on the premise that
eight-f01.usage: 指出论证前提：be grounded on the premise that + 完整从句。
eight-f01.example: The proposal is grounded on the premise that every household has reliable internet.

eight-f01.usage: 经济收益：generate tax revenue from + 销售/活动。
eight-f01.example: A well-managed tourism sector generates tax revenue that can support local services.

eight-f01.usage: 给判断理由：given + N；相当于考虑到该因素。
eight-f01.example: Given students’ practical needs, evening transport services deserve attention.

eight-f02.usage: 关联而非确证唯一因果：be associated with + N/V-ing。
eight-f02.example: Long journeys may be associated with fatigue and reduced family time.

eight-f02.usage: 限定程度：consume/use/enjoy + N + in moderation。
eight-f02.example: Digital entertainment can be enjoyable when used in moderation.

eight-f02.usage: 说明负担情景：face a heavy workload；workload为可数负担量。
eight-f02.example: Teachers facing a heavy workload may need more administrative support.

eight-f02.usage: 区分问题与措施合理性：X do not, by themselves, justify + N/V-ing。
eight-f02.example: Occasional delays do not, by themselves, justify closing an entire railway line.

eight-f02.usage: 信息支持：help + sb + (to) make informed choices about + N。
eight-f02.example: Career workshops can help students make informed choices about vocational courses.

eight-f03.phrase: the convenience of and ready access to
eight-f03.usage: 并列名词各带介词：the convenience of + N；ready access to + N。
eight-f03.example: Learners value the convenience of and ready access to recorded lectures.

eight-f03.phrase: invest a lot of time in preparing
eight-f03.usage: 时间投入：invest time in + V-ing；in不是to。
eight-f03.example: Residents may be unwilling to invest a lot of time in maintaining a shared garden.

eight-f03.usage: 相对不重要：X pale into insignificance compared with + Y。
eight-f03.example: Small savings may pale into insignificance compared with the value of reliable medical care.

eight-f03.phrase: represent the cultural identity of a group
eight-f03.usage: 文化象征：represent the cultural identity of + 群体。
eight-f03.example: Local festivals can represent the cultural identity of a group.

eight-f03.phrase: their emotional bond can be strengthened
eight-f03.usage: 关系结果：an emotional bond can be strengthened by + V-ing。
eight-f03.example: The emotional bond between teammates can be strengthened by working towards a shared goal.

eight-a01.phrase: the benefits that accrue to companies and children
eight-a01.usage: 利益归属：benefits that accrue to + 受益者；that引导定语从句。
eight-a01.example: The benefits that accrue to local residents should be considered when funding festivals.

eight-a01.usage: 选项多样：choose among / offer + a wide array of + 复数名词。
eight-a01.example: Public libraries offer a wide array of options for independent study.

eight-a01.phrase: the fine line between persuasive advertising and misleading information
eight-a01.usage: 相近概念边界：the fine line between + A + and + B。
eight-a01.example: Teachers should recognise the fine line between encouragement and excessive pressure.

eight-a01.usage: 易受影响：be susceptible to + N；不表示必然上当。
eight-a01.example: Inexperienced tourists may be susceptible to misleading sales tactics.

eight-a01.usage: 辨别两者：make the distinction between + A + and + B。
eight-a01.example: Students need to make the distinction between memorising a rule and understanding its use.

eight-a02.usage: 习惯结构：develop the habit of + V-ing；it回指不可数advertising。
eight-a02.example: Students can develop the habit of checking their work before submission.

eight-a02.usage: 与目标一致：align with + N；aligns由单数主语决定。
eight-a02.example: Vocational training should align with local employment needs.

eight-a02.usage: 激发兴趣：spark + 人’s interest in + N/V-ing。
eight-a02.example: A visit to a museum can spark pupils’ interest in local history.

eight-a02.usage: 倾向行为：be inclined to + V；不是必然选择。
eight-a02.example: Learners may be inclined to choose courses recommended by trusted classmates.

eight-a02.usage: 经济作用：stimulate + spending/demand；需说明信息或激励机制。
eight-a02.example: Improved access to town centres may stimulate consumer spending in local shops.

eight-a03.usage: 推动现象：act as a catalyst for + N/V-ing；不是唯一原因。
eight-a03.example: International cooperation acts as a catalyst for scientific exchange.

eight-a03.usage: 信息处理：data are run through + 算法/系统；run过去分词同形。
eight-a03.example: Traffic data can be run through algorithms to identify congested routes.

eight-a03.phrase: weigh their needs against the cost
eight-a03.usage: 比较权衡：weigh + A + against + B。
eight-a03.example: Policymakers should weigh the benefits of new stadiums against the cost.

eight-a03.usage: 有实际用途：serve + a practical purpose；不等于只追求低价。
eight-a03.example: Community language classes serve a practical purpose for new residents.

eight-a03.usage: 回应已有需求：respond to + N；区别于制造需要。
eight-a03.example: Evening childcare can respond to an existing need among shift workers.

eight-a04.phrase: acts as a vehicle for promotion
eight-a04.usage: 承担传播功能：act as a vehicle for + N；vehicle为比喻。
eight-a04.example: A local festival can act as a vehicle for cultural exchange.

eight-a04.usage: 潜在购买者：introduce products to / attract + prospective buyers。
eight-a04.example: Clear online descriptions can help prospective buyers compare handmade products.

eight-a04.phrase: beyond the reach of all but the wealthy
eight-a04.usage: 可获得性差距：be beyond the reach of + 人；all but此处为除……之外皆。
eight-a04.example: High university fees may put some courses beyond the reach of all but the wealthy.

eight-a04.usage: 物质财产：regard material possessions as + 评价；不是精神财富。
eight-a04.example: Children should not learn to measure personal worth solely through material possessions.

eight-a04.usage: 主动判断：adopt a critical attitude towards + N。
eight-a04.example: Students should adopt a more critical attitude towards unverified online information.

eight-a05.usage: 高度重视：put a premium on + N/V-ing；不是字面溢价。
eight-a05.example: Employers may put a premium on practical experience when recruiting technicians.

eight-a05.usage: 获得想要物品：get one’s hands on + N；hands复数，介词on。
eight-a05.example: Young readers may queue to get their hands on a popular novel.

eight-a05.usage: 与竞争者区分：distinguish A from + B；the competition指竞争对手整体。
eight-a05.example: Small museums can distinguish themselves from the competition through local expertise.

eight-a05.usage: 收益归属：the resulting benefits could accrue to + 人；benefits作主语。
eight-a05.example: If buses become more reliable, the resulting benefits could accrue to workers and students.

eight-a05.phrase: places an unnecessary financial burden on consumers
eight-a05.usage: 财务代价：place a financial burden on + 承受者。
eight-a05.example: Frequent changes to school uniforms place an unnecessary financial burden on parents.

eight-l01.usage: 高度重视：place a premium on + N/V-ing。
eight-l01.example: Universities should place a premium on helping students evaluate evidence.

eight-l01.usage: 建立并巩固关系：foster/cement + relationships with + 人。
eight-l01.example: Joint community projects can foster and cement relationships between neighbours.

eight-l01.usage: 减少沟通障碍：break down + barriers to + N/V-ing。
eight-l01.example: Accessible teaching materials can break down barriers to adult education.

eight-l01.usage: 共同交流语言：use/need + a lingua franca；单数可数名词需冠词。
eight-l01.example: An international sporting event may need a lingua franca for volunteers from different countries.

eight-l01.usage: 扩大获取机会：widen access to + N；access通常不可数。
eight-l01.example: Free public libraries can widen access to knowledge in disadvantaged communities.

eight-l02.phrase: spare students the trouble of learning
eight-l02.usage: 省去麻烦：spare + sb + the trouble of + V-ing。
eight-l02.example: Clear transport information can spare visitors the trouble of asking for directions.

eight-l02.usage: 形成熟练掌握：develop a good command of + 语言/知识领域。
eight-l02.example: Apprentices need to develop a good command of basic safety procedures.

eight-l02.usage: 机会成本：time that would otherwise be spent on + N/V-ing。
eight-l02.example: Time that would otherwise be spent on paperwork could be used for lesson planning.

eight-l02.phrase: prevent the message from getting garbled
eight-l02.usage: 防止失真：prevent + N + from + V-ing；message为被影响对象。
eight-l02.example: Careful instructions can prevent new employees from making avoidable mistakes.

eight-l02.phrase: have access to a specific culture
eight-l02.usage: 获得文化入口：have access to + N，不把access当可数。
eight-l02.example: Affordable exhibitions give schoolchildren access to a wider range of artistic traditions.

eight-l03.usage: 天赋能力：have/lack a natural aptitude for + N/V-ing。
eight-l03.example: A natural aptitude for drawing does not remove the need for regular practice.

eight-l03.usage: 相似度低：A have little in common with + B。
eight-l03.example: A classroom simulation may have little in common with the pressure of a real workplace.

eight-l03.usage: 投入领域：devote oneself/time to + N/V-ing，to为介词。
eight-l03.example: Employees could devote more time to developing transferable skills.

eight-l03.phrase: a means of broadening their horizons
eight-l03.usage: 途径作用：a means of + V-ing；broaden one’s horizons拓宽视野。
eight-l03.example: Volunteering can be a means of broadening young people’s horizons.

eight-l03.phrase: with teaching and expectations adapted to their needs
eight-l03.usage: 条件配套：with + N + 过去分词；adapt X to + 需要。
eight-l03.example: A public exercise programme can be inclusive, with activities adapted to participants’ needs.

eight-c01.usage: 行为示范：set a good example for + 人；example可被关系从句展开。
eight-c01.example: Teachers can set a good example for pupils by checking uncertain information.

eight-c01.phrase: have a propensity for aggressive behaviour
eight-c01.usage: 描述倾向：have a propensity for + N/V-ing；不代表必然行为。
eight-c01.example: Some businesses have a propensity for prioritising short-term sales over service quality.

eight-c01.phrase: be it in video games or violent movies
eight-c01.usage: 两类场景推广：be it + A + or + B，正式表达。
eight-c01.example: Students need reliable guidance, be it in academic study or vocational training.

eight-c01.phrase: the extent to which they are culpable
eight-c01.usage: 程度限定：the extent to which + 主谓；culpable为应负责任。
eight-c01.example: Schools should consider the extent to which their rules affect disadvantaged families.

eight-c01.phrase: take the offender's maturity into account
eight-c01.usage: 纳入判断：take + 因素 + into account。
eight-c01.example: Course designers should take learners’ prior knowledge into account.

eight-c02.usage: 相称处罚：punishment proportionate to + 罪行；形容词用proportionate。
eight-c02.example: Schools should use proportionate sanctions for repeated rule violations.

eight-c02.phrase: weigh the benefits against the risks
eight-c02.usage: 权衡两侧：weigh + benefits + against + risks。
eight-c02.example: Tourists should weigh the benefits of remote travel against the risks to fragile environments.

eight-c02.usage: 减轻情形：X may be a mitigating factor；不是自动免罚条件。
eight-c02.example: A lack of clear instructions may be a mitigating factor when assessing an employee’s mistake.

eight-c02.phrase: are led astray by extrinsic factors
eight-c02.usage: 受到外在因素误导：be led astray by + 原因；lead过去分词led。
eight-c02.example: Young consumers may be led astray by exaggerated claims about expensive products.

eight-c02.phrase: tailored to the maturity of delinquents
eight-c02.usage: 按特征适配：tailor + N + to + 需要/特征；被动为be tailored to。
eight-c02.example: Support sessions should be tailored to the needs of new language learners.

eight-c03.phrase: weigh the potential rewards against the punishment
eight-c03.usage: 得失比较：weigh + 收益 + against + 代价。
eight-c03.example: Employees may weigh the potential rewards of promotion against the additional workload.

eight-c03.usage: 克制行动：refrain from + V-ing，from后不可接原形。
eight-c03.example: Consumers may refrain from buying unnecessary products when they track their spending.

eight-c03.usage: 逃脱应负后果：escape + justice，不加from。
eight-c03.example: Stronger checks can make it harder for fraudulent advertisers to escape justice.

eight-c03.usage: 培养判断：develop + 能力名词；developing为by后的V-ing。
eight-c03.example: Literature discussions can help pupils develop moral judgment without prescribing a single answer.

eight-c03.usage: 共同协作：make concerted efforts to + V；说明参与主体。
eight-c03.example: Schools and families should make concerted efforts to support struggling readers.

eight-c04.usage: 获得稳定岗位：secure + a job/employment；不指工作安全。
eight-c04.example: Vocational courses can help school leavers secure a job in skilled trades.

eight-c04.usage: 谋生方式：as a means of livelihood；means单复数同形。
eight-c04.example: Traditional crafts remain a means of livelihood for some rural households.

eight-c04.usage: 就业障碍：a barrier to + N/V-ing；to是介词。
eight-c04.example: Unaffordable transport can be a major barrier to employment in remote areas.

eight-c04.phrase: a sense of self-efficacy and accomplishment
eight-c04.usage: 能力信念与成就感：develop a sense of + 抽象名词。
eight-c04.example: Completing a group project can give students a sense of self-efficacy and accomplishment.

eight-c04.usage: 稳定生活安排：provide a stabilizing routine for + 人。
eight-c04.example: Regular sports sessions can provide a stabilizing routine for new university students.

eight-e01.usage: 机会丰富：a wealth of + N；wealth为丰富量而非仅金钱。
eight-e01.example: Learning digital skills may open up a wealth of job opportunities for older workers.

eight-e01.phrase: does not necessarily amount to success
eight-e01.usage: 否定等同：X does not necessarily amount to + N。
eight-e01.example: A large tourism industry does not necessarily amount to prosperity for local residents.

eight-e01.usage: 实践与岗位针对性：provide/receive + hands-on, job-specific instruction。
eight-e01.example: New museum guides could receive hands-on, job-specific instruction before leading tours.

eight-e01.usage: 提供机会：afford + 人 + access to + N；不同于afford to do负担得起。
eight-e01.example: An affordable bus network affords rural residents access to medical services.

eight-e01.phrase: should not be defined in terms of
eight-e01.usage: 界定标准：define X in terms of + N；被动be defined。
eight-e01.example: A successful city should not be defined in terms of economic output alone.

eight-e02.phrase: equip students with the skills and knowledge
eight-e02.usage: 赋予能力：equip + sb + with + N；不能equip sb of。
eight-e02.example: Community classes can equip older residents with the skills and knowledge needed for online services.

eight-e02.phrase: the alignment between the goal of education and the growing needs of the job market
eight-e02.usage: 目标匹配：the alignment between + A + and + B。
eight-e02.example: The alignment between bus routes and residents’ travel needs can improve public transport use.

eight-e02.usage: 实际操作经验：gain/provide + hands-on experience in + N/V-ing。
eight-e02.example: Conservation projects give volunteers hands-on experience in maintaining habitats.

eight-e02.phrase: a broad foundation in general education
eight-e02.usage: 基础构建：a broad foundation in + 领域。
eight-e02.example: A broad foundation in science can help citizens evaluate environmental claims.

eight-e02.usage: 行使选择自由：exercise one’s freedom to + V。
eight-e02.example: Adults should be able to exercise their freedom to choose suitable training courses.

eight-e03.usage: 混合能力教学：teach students in + mixed-ability classes。
eight-e03.example: Mixed-ability classes in community sports can encourage mutual support.

eight-e03.usage: 受污名感：feel/be stigmatized by/as + N；此处可能损害心理。
eight-e03.example: Residents may feel stigmatized when public support is described as a personal failure.
Repeated public criticism can undermine employees’ confidence and self-esteem.

eight-e03.usage: 理解吸收：assimilate + knowledge/information；不是只死记。
eight-e03.example: Practical demonstrations can help apprentices assimilate new knowledge.

eight-e03.usage: 制度可变性：allow movement between + 复数群组；allowing作伴随补充。
eight-e03.example: Adult courses can remain flexible by allowing movement between groups as learners progress.

eight-e04.usage: 程度限定：little, if any, + 不可数名词；if any两侧逗号。
eight-e04.example: New volunteers may have little, if any, hands-on experience in habitat restoration.

eight-e04.usage: 资金投入：channel money/time into + N/V-ing；此处被动。
eight-e04.example: Funds could be channelled into improving public transport reliability.

eight-e04.usage: 获得专业胜任能力：acquire + competence in + 领域；不是竞争力competitiveness。
eight-e04.example: Supervised practice helps trainee nurses acquire professional competence.

eight-e04.usage: 应对突发紧急情况：cope with + N；unforeseeable不能预见的。
eight-e04.example: Well-trained tour guides may be better able to cope with unforeseeable emergencies.

eight-e04.phrase: an indispensable aspect of higher education
eight-e04.usage: 必要组成：an indispensable aspect of + N；本篇对象为高教内容。
eight-e04.example: Critical reading is an indispensable aspect of responsible media use.

eight-e05.phrase: devote substantial time to their studies
eight-e05.usage: 时间分配：devote + time + to + N/V-ing；to是介词。
eight-e05.example: Local councils should devote substantial time to consulting residents before changing bus routes.

eight-e05.usage: 共同兴趣者：interact with / meet + like-minded people。
eight-e05.example: Community gardens allow residents to meet like-minded people.

eight-e05.usage: 磨炼或获取能力：sharpen/acquire + skills；不可sharpen人。
eight-e05.example: Volunteering can help young adults sharpen or acquire skills in teamwork.

eight-e05.phrase: an important ingredient of personal socialization
eight-e05.usage: 组成因素：an important ingredient of + 过程/结果。
eight-e05.example: Trust is an important ingredient of effective international cooperation.

eight-e05.phrase: Only when the pursuit of academic achievement is integrated with social learning through activities can
eight-e05.usage: 必要条件倒装：Only when + 正常从句 + can + 主语 + V。
eight-e05.example: Only when safer routes are combined with affordable fares can public transport attract more drivers.

eight-e06.phrase: the focused use of effort and attention
eight-e06.usage: 投入方式：the focused use of + 资源；focused指集中而非量最大。
eight-e06.example: The focused use of public funds can improve services on overcrowded bus routes.

eight-e06.usage: 知识前沿：work/research at the frontiers of + 领域/knowledge。
eight-e06.example: Researchers at the frontiers of environmental science need to exchange ideas across disciplines.

eight-e06.usage: 职业晋升：help + sb + climb the career ladder。
eight-e06.example: Communication skills can help employees climb the career ladder in international firms.

eight-e06.usage: 互补关系：complement + N，不能加with作该动词宾语结构。
eight-e06.example: Experience of volunteering can complement the professional competence gained through formal study.

eight-e06.phrase: equips them to sharpen their skills and knowledge
eight-e06.usage: 能力准备：equip + sb + to + V；sharpen + skills/knowledge。
eight-e06.example: Critical reading equips students to evaluate unfamiliar claims more carefully.

nine-01.usage: 主动调整以适应；adapt to + N/V-ing，to是介词。
nine-01.example: New employees may need time to adapt to working with an international team.

nine-01.usage: 减轻后果而非消除根源；alleviate + effects of N，its须有清楚指代。
nine-01.example: School examinations may cause anxiety, but clear guidance can alleviate its effects.

nine-01.usage: 降低依赖；reduce reliance on + N/V-ing。
nine-01.example: Better buses could reduce reliance on private cars.

nine-01.usage: 指出替代资源；alternative + N，sources可用作develop的宾语。
nine-01.example: Schools could explore alternative funding sources before raising tuition fees.

nine-01.usage: 强调不应低估；N + should never be underestimated，被动后不再加宾语。
nine-01.example: The value of regular feedback should never be underestimated in language learning.

nine-02.usage: 给出道德辩护而非事实解释；N/V-ing + can be morally justified + 条件。
nine-02.example: Temporary restrictions on travel can be morally justified when they protect people from an immediate danger.

nine-02.usage: 强调唯一依赖对象；rely solely on + N/V-ing，随后应检查有无替代。
nine-02.example: Rural schools should not rely solely on unpaid volunteers.

nine-02.usage: 引入必要条件；provided that + 完整从句。
nine-02.example: Remote working can be expanded, provided that staff receive adequate technical support.

nine-02.usage: 说明实施或生产规模；produce/implement + N + on a large scale。
nine-02.example: Affordable learning materials can be distributed on a large scale through online platforms.

nine-02.usage: 表达严厉禁止；a strict prohibition on + N/V-ing。
nine-02.example: A strict prohibition on misleading advertisements could protect vulnerable consumers.

nine-03.usage: 防止灭绝；prevent + 对象 + from V-ing，die out不及物。
nine-03.example: Affordable meals can prevent students from dropping out because of financial pressure.

nine-03.usage: 更能适应环境；better-adapted + N，也可be better adapted to + N。
nine-03.example: Better-adapted teaching materials can support learners with different needs.

nine-03.usage: 表达相关而非已证实因果；A correlate with B。
nine-03.example: Long commuting times may correlate with lower job satisfaction.

nine-03.usage: 说明两选项互斥；A and B + be mutually exclusive，否定时表示可以并存。
nine-03.example: Economic growth and fair working conditions need not be mutually exclusive.

nine-03.usage: 说明影响范围广或持久；have far-reaching effects on + N。
nine-03.example: Unequal access to education can have far-reaching effects on employment opportunities.

nine-04.usage: 区分对象；A should be distinguished from B，情态动词后保留be。
nine-04.example: Temporary unemployment should be distinguished from a long-term skills mismatch.

nine-04.usage: 说明理由不足；there is insufficient justification for + N/V-ing。
nine-04.example: There is insufficient justification for banning all online lessons because some are poorly designed.

nine-04.usage: 表达应受保护；对象 + deserve protection from + 伤害。
nine-04.example: Children deserve protection from misleading commercial messages.

nine-04.usage: 强调相互联系；复数事物 + be closely interconnected，不能据此推出价值相等。
nine-04.example: Housing costs and commuting choices are closely interconnected.

nine-04.phrase: according to the threats they face
nine-04.usage: 按风险分配；according to + N/名词性结构，they应有明确先行词。
nine-04.example: Schools could direct support to learners according to the difficulties they face.

nine-05.phrase: depriving countless species of their natural homes
nine-05.usage: 用分词写结果；deprive + 对象 + of + N，不能写from。
nine-05.example: Excessive overtime can deprive workers of their opportunity to rest.

nine-05.usage: 说明需求推动行为；be driven by demand for + N。
nine-05.example: The expansion of online courses is partly driven by high demand for flexible study.

nine-05.usage: 区分保护与修复；efforts to + V，也可将整组作主语。
nine-05.example: Maintenance and restoration efforts could make old schools safer to use.

nine-05.phrase: take to halt and reverse the trend
nine-05.usage: 询问具体步骤；take steps to + V，halt停止、reverse扭转。
nine-05.example: What steps can employers take to halt and reverse the trend towards longer working hours?

nine-05.usage: 造成严重损害；have/has taken a heavy toll on + N。
nine-05.example: Repeated delays have taken a heavy toll on passengers' confidence in the rail service.

nine-06.usage: 可支配收入，即缴税后可用于消费或储蓄的收入；disposable income 通常不可数，不等于扣除基本生活开销后的剩余收入。
nine-06.example: Higher disposable income may allow families to buy additional learning materials.

nine-06.usage: 描述群体扩大；the middle class + 单数谓语，不写the number...proliferates。
nine-06.example: As the local workforce is expanding, demand for reliable public transport may rise.

nine-06.usage: 展示范围；ranging from + A + to + B，两端结构应平行。
nine-06.example: Students need support ranging from academic advice to affordable accommodation.

nine-06.usage: 多方协同行动；concerted efforts from + 主体，须补谁做什么。
nine-06.example: Improving school meals requires concerted efforts from teachers and catering staff.

nine-06.usage: 限定积极结论；provided that + 完整条件从句。
nine-06.example: Longer opening hours could benefit library users, provided that staffing costs remain manageable.

nine-07.usage: 说明外汇收益；earn + foreign exchange，exchange此义不可数。
nine-07.example: Exporting educational software can help small firms earn foreign exchange.

nine-07.usage: 损害某对象；N + take its toll on + N，its指前述事物。
nine-07.example: Persistent staff shortages can take their toll on hospital services.

nine-07.usage: 高度重视；place a premium on + N/V-ing。
nine-07.example: Employers should place a premium on relevant skills when recruiting graduates.

nine-07.usage: 把活动视为实现目标的载体；become/serve as a vehicle for + N/V-ing。
nine-07.example: Community theatre can serve as a vehicle for discussing local concerns.

nine-07.usage: 增强归属感；heighten a sense of + N，不表示人数增加。
nine-07.example: Inclusive school activities may heighten a sense of belonging among new pupils.

nine-08.usage: 承认部分替代但否定完全替代；A cannot fully replace B。
nine-08.example: Recorded lessons cannot fully replace individual feedback from a teacher.

nine-08.usage: 列出无论哪种资源；resource, be it A or B，正式让步结构。
nine-08.example: Every form of support, be it advice or funding, should address a clear need.

nine-08.phrase: in the comfort of their own homes
nine-08.usage: 说明在家舒适获取；in the comfort of + 所有格 + own home(s)。
nine-08.example: Older patients can speak to a doctor in the comfort of their own homes.

nine-08.phrase: discrepancy between the plan and the reality
nine-08.usage: 比较预期与实际差距；a discrepancy between A and B。
nine-08.example: A discrepancy between advertised prices and final charges may damage consumer trust.

nine-08.usage: 不能完整复现体验；媒介 + cannot fully reproduce + N。
nine-08.example: A virtual laboratory cannot fully reproduce the experience of handling physical equipment.

nine-09.usage: 容易受某因素影响；be susceptible to + N，to是介词。
nine-09.example: Inexperienced consumers may be susceptible to misleading advertising.

nine-09.usage: 处理人际冲突；cope with + N，不直接接宾语。
nine-09.example: School mediation programmes can help pupils cope with interpersonal conflicts.

nine-09.usage: 适度使用；be played in moderation，也可consume/use N in moderation。
nine-09.example: Social media can support communication when used in moderation.
Practical craft lessons may improve children's hand-eye coordination.

nine-09.phrase: fictional elements need to be distinguished from historical facts
nine-09.usage: 区分虚构与事实；A need to be distinguished from B。
nine-09.example: In science lessons, tentative explanations need to be distinguished from established findings.

nine-10.usage: 随时容易接触；the ready accessibility of + N，区别有没有与负担得起。
nine-10.example: The ready accessibility of online dictionaries can support independent reading.

nine-10.phrase: switch off from the pressures of real life
nine-10.usage: 暂时摆脱压力；switch off from + N，不等于解决压力根源。
nine-10.example: A short walk can help employees switch off from the pressures of work.

nine-10.usage: 使人持续投入；keep + 对象 + 形容词或分词，不写keep sb to do。
nine-10.example: Interactive museum exhibits can keep visitors occupied while they wait for a tour.

nine-10.usage: 表达时间的替代用途；time + that could otherwise be spent with + 人。
nine-10.example: Long commutes consume time that could otherwise be spent with children.

nine-10.usage: 主动发展其他兴趣；pursue + hobby/interest，不必加介词。
nine-10.example: A shorter working week may give employees time to pursue other hobbies.

nine-11.phrase: distinguishing between the virtual world and reality
nine-11.usage: 区分两对象；have difficulty distinguishing between A and B，difficulty后接V-ing。
nine-11.example: Some consumers have difficulty distinguishing between reliable advice and paid promotion.

nine-11.usage: 处理人际冲突；cope with + N。
nine-11.example: Workplace training can teach staff to cope with interpersonal conflicts through discussion.

nine-11.usage: 通过他人经历获得刺激；experience a vicarious thrill，不推出实际行为意愿。
nine-11.example: Reading an adventure novel can give pupils a vicarious thrill without exposing them to danger.

nine-11.usage: 劝阻某种行为；be dissuaded from + N/V-ing。
nine-11.example: Drivers may be dissuaded from speeding when they understand the risks to pedestrians.

nine-11.usage: 施加针对性限制；impose restrictions on + 内容或行为。
nine-11.example: Schools may impose appropriate restrictions on phone use during lessons.

nine-12.usage: 缺乏任职准备或条件；be ill-equipped to + V，应以实际能力证明。
nine-12.example: Schools without reliable internet may be ill-equipped to work with digital teaching platforms.

nine-12.usage: 排除性别作为筛选依据；regardless of + N。
nine-12.example: All applicants should receive the same assessment regardless of age.

nine-12.usage: 说明任务依赖能力；rely on + N/V-ing。
nine-12.example: Effective customer support may rely on judgement and communication as well as technical knowledge.

nine-12.usage: 列出不止一个基础；X rests not only on A but also on B，结构平行。
nine-12.example: Successful language learning rests not only on memory but also on regular practice.

nine-12.usage: 参与的关键作用；play a central role in + N/V-ing；正文的play被插入语隔开。
nine-12.example: Parents can play a central role in helping children develop healthy reading habits.

nine-13.usage: 家庭主要收入提供者；be/become breadwinners，勿与所有就业者混同。
nine-13.example: Flexible training can help unemployed parents become breadwinners again.

nine-13.usage: 从财务上合理；it makes financial sense for + 人 + to V。
nine-13.example: It may make financial sense for a small company to rent shared office space.

nine-13.usage: 未来收入机会；have stronger/better earning prospects than + 比较对象。
nine-13.example: Graduates with practical experience may have better earning prospects than equally qualified applicants without it.

nine-13.usage: 重视家庭；be family-oriented或a family-oriented + N，不代表缺乏事业投入。
nine-13.example: Family-oriented workplace policies may improve staff retention.

nine-13.usage: 选择自主权；freedom of choice over + N，本文涉及工作与照护。
nine-13.example: Students need freedom of choice over optional subjects.

nine-14.usage: 指不分情况的统一要求；impose/introduce N as a blanket requirement。
nine-14.example: Daily office attendance may be unnecessary as a blanket requirement for all staff.

nine-14.usage: 被拒绝录取名额；be denied places in + 专业或机构。
nine-14.example: Qualified rural applicants may be denied places if interviews are only held in distant cities.

nine-14.usage: 自由选择；protect/restrict freedom of choice，说明选择对象。
nine-14.example: A wider range of bus routes can increase commuters' freedom of choice.

nine-14.usage: 对某对象的偏好：a preference / preferences for + N/V-ing；for 标示偏好对象。
nine-14.example: People's preferences for working hours may change after they become parents.

nine-14.usage: 单一现象不足证明结论；A is not in itself evidence of B。
nine-14.example: A low price is not in itself evidence of poor product quality.

nine-15.phrase: in favour of this equal-number policy
nine-15.usage: 引出政策支持理由；the argument in favour of + N/V-ing。
nine-15.example: The argument in favour of free school meals is that every child can eat during the school day.

nine-15.usage: 高度重视或偏向；place a premium on + N。
nine-15.example: Recruiters should place a premium on demonstrated competence rather than familiar university names.

nine-15.usage: 进入职业的机会；improve/provide access to + N，access不可数。
nine-15.example: Affordable apprenticeships can improve access to skilled professions.

nine-15.phrase: barriers to the full and equal participation
nine-15.usage: 阻碍充分平等参与；barriers to + N/V-ing，to是介词。
nine-15.example: Unreliable transport can create barriers to the full and equal participation of rural students.

nine-15.usage: 明确歧视涉及何事；discrimination related to + N，不用松散about。
nine-15.example: Recruitment rules should address discrimination related to age and disability.

nine-16.usage: 无需跨越语言障碍；communicate/appreciate N without a language barrier。
nine-16.example: Clear diagrams can help visitors understand safety instructions without a language barrier.

nine-16.usage: 与听众情绪共鸣；N may resonate emotionally with + 人。
nine-16.example: A documentary about family separation may resonate emotionally with migrant workers.

nine-16.usage: 准确传递信息；convey + information + accurately，不与定义混淆。
nine-16.example: Public transport signs should convey information accurately to unfamiliar passengers.

nine-16.usage: 交换精确思想；exchange + N，通常需共同语境。
nine-16.example: Shared terminology helps engineers exchange precise ideas during a complex project.

nine-16.usage: 超出口语表达；N goes beyond + N，关系从句须有谓语。
nine-16.example: A learner's confidence goes beyond spoken language and may affect classroom participation.

nine-17.usage: 暂时不想烦恼；take + 人的mind(s) + off + N。
nine-17.example: An outdoor break can take students' minds off a difficult assignment.

nine-17.usage: 作为背景播放；play music/audio in the background。
nine-17.example: A recorded announcement may be difficult to hear when other audio is playing in the background.

nine-17.usage: 振奋情绪；lift + 人的spirits，spirits用复数。
nine-17.example: Encouraging feedback can lift employees' spirits after a demanding week.

nine-17.usage: 带来安慰愉悦；bring + N + to + 人，勿机械用trigger。
nine-17.example: A familiar public garden can bring comfort and enjoyment to older residents.

nine-17.phrase: judged by their contribution to everyday well-being
nine-17.usage: 明确评价标准；judged by + N，contribution to + N/V-ing。
nine-17.example: Judged by their contribution to community well-being, affordable bus services may deserve priority.

nine-18.usage: 承担前述职责；shoulder responsibility for + N/V-ing。
nine-18.example: Employers should shoulder responsibility for maintaining safe working conditions.

nine-18.usage: 提供经费；provide funding to + V / for + N，不写pay for the money。
nine-18.example: Councils could provide funding to repair unsafe pedestrian crossings.

nine-18.phrase: have the capacity to do so
nine-18.usage: 表达执行能力；have the capacity to + V，do so回指前一动作。
nine-18.example: Small schools may wish to offer specialist courses but lack the capacity to do so.

nine-18.usage: 在两方间找折中；seek a compromise between A and B。
nine-18.example: Transport planners should seek a compromise between faster journeys and quieter neighbourhoods.

nine-18.usage: 基本服务平等可及；have/ensure equal access to + N，access不可数。
nine-18.example: Digital reform should preserve equal access to basic services for people without smartphones.

nine-19.usage: 承担部分责任；shoulder responsibility for + N/V-ing，some不表示唯一。
nine-19.example: Technology firms should shoulder some responsibility for helping users identify misleading content.

nine-19.usage: 财务上可行；be financially viable，须比较成本与可用资源。
nine-19.example: A new theatre may attract audiences but must also be financially viable.

nine-19.usage: 为后续发展打基础；lay the groundwork for + N/V-ing。
nine-19.example: Early reading practice can lay the groundwork for independent learning.

nine-19.usage: 全额资助金；provide full grants to + 人 / for + N，grants区别于需还款loans。
nine-19.example: A council could provide full grants for essential repairs in low-income households.

nine-19.phrase: public funding can later be recovered
nine-19.usage: 说明资金回收可能；funding + can be recovered，不推出零成本。
nine-19.example: If the project earns fees, some public funding can later be recovered.

nine-20.usage: 承担某事责任；take responsibility for + N/V-ing，不等于only负责。
nine-20.example: Schools should take responsibility for keeping play areas safe.

nine-20.usage: 说明由谁合作行动；concerted efforts by + 复数主体。
nine-20.example: Reducing traffic around schools requires concerted efforts by councils and families.

nine-20.usage: 区分立法与执法；introduce and enforce + laws，不把enforce当颁布。
nine-20.example: Authorities can introduce and enforce laws against deceptive financial advertising.

nine-20.phrase: time that could otherwise be spent on
nine-20.usage: 时间机会成本；time that could otherwise be spent on + N/V-ing。
nine-20.example: Unnecessary meetings consume time that could otherwise be spent on preparing lessons.

nine-20.usage: 创造有利环境；an environment conducive to + N/V-ing，to是介词。
nine-20.example: Quiet libraries offer an environment conducive to independent study.

nine-21.usage: 促成某进展；act as a catalyst for + N/V-ing，不表示唯一原因。
nine-21.example: Affordable childcare can act as a catalyst for wider participation in employment.

nine-21.usage: 努力追求卓越；strive for + N，也可strive to + V。
nine-21.example: Regular feedback can encourage trainees to strive for excellence.

nine-21.usage: 说明成果依赖多方；X rests on the efforts of + 人或团队。
nine-21.example: The success of a public festival rests on the efforts of volunteers and local organisers.

nine-21.usage: 达成折中；reach a compromise when + 完整从句，勿用comprise。
nine-21.example: Residents and developers may reach a compromise when their priorities differ.

nine-21.phrase: well equipped for their future lives
nine-21.usage: 为未来做好准备；be well equipped for + N / to + V。
nine-21.example: Practical budgeting lessons can leave school leavers well equipped for independent life.

nine-22.phrase: So interconnected is the world that
nine-22.usage: 强调程度的倒装；So + 形容词 + be + 主语 + that + 完整结果句，that前不加逗号。
nine-22.example: So limited is the school budget that essential repairs must be prioritised.

nine-22.usage: 承担减轻某问题的责任；responsibility for + V-ing。
nine-22.example: Employers share responsibility for mitigating workplace stress.

nine-22.usage: 承认程度不同；完整判断后接albeit + 短语，勿另当主句。
nine-22.example: Rising housing costs affect many households, albeit to varying degrees.

nine-22.usage: 限定短期效果；have limited immediate effects on + N，不等于不可行。
nine-22.example: New cycling lanes may have limited immediate effects where few residents own bicycles.

nine-22.phrase: without waiting for an international agreement
nine-22.usage: 突出可独立行动；without + V-ing，wait for + N。
nine-22.example: A town can repair unsafe crossings without waiting for a national transport reform.

nine-23.phrase: impose a heavy financial burden on
nine-23.usage: 把负担落到承担者；impose a burden on + 人或机构，不用to。
nine-23.example: Unexpected tuition increases can impose a heavy financial burden on low-income families.

nine-23.usage: 交通基础设施；infrastructure不可数，build/improve + infrastructure。
nine-23.example: Better transport infrastructure could connect rural workers with urban jobs.

nine-23.usage: 提高声望或地位；人或机构 + grow in stature，不等于规模增长。
nine-23.example: A university may grow in stature when its research addresses important public needs.

nine-23.usage: 财务上可行；become/be financially viable，收入与成本均需评估。
nine-23.example: A free museum may remain financially viable if stable grants cover its operating costs.

nine-23.usage: 总收入而非净利润；generate/report gross revenue，利润需扣成本。
nine-23.example: High gross revenue does not guarantee that an online retailer can cover delivery and storage costs.

nine-24.phrase: have the edge over their competitors
nine-24.usage: 具有竞争优势；have the edge over + 对手，不等于保证获胜。
nine-24.example: Applicants with practical experience may have the edge over their competitors.

nine-24.usage: 更依赖某基础；hinge on + N/V-ing，more需比较对象。
nine-24.example: The success of online learning may hinge more on consistent feedback than on expensive software.

nine-24.phrase: greater than the sum of its parts
nine-24.usage: 整体产生协作增益；be greater than the sum of its parts。
nine-24.example: A research group can be greater than the sum of its parts when members share different skills.

nine-24.usage: 战胜强劲对手；overcome + N，勿用make sb over。
nine-24.example: A small firm may overcome strong opponents by serving a neglected market.

nine-24.usage: 突破自身能力边界；push + 所有格 + limits，常用复数。
nine-24.example: Challenging projects can encourage students to push their limits.

nine-25.usage: 按比例对应；be in proportion to + N，说明评价尺度。
nine-25.example: Training budgets should be in proportion to employees' actual learning needs.

nine-25.usage: 卓越才能而非泛指真实才能；have/possess exceptional talent，talent不可数。
nine-25.example: Scholarships can help students with exceptional talent continue their education.

nine-25.usage: 受到公众密切关注；be in the spotlight，区别out of。
nine-25.example: A public official in the spotlight may face intense scrutiny over everyday decisions.

nine-25.usage: 产生商业收入；generate + revenue，不自动等于净利润。
nine-25.example: Popular educational videos can generate commercial revenue for their creators.

nine-25.usage: 分享前述收入的较大份额；receive a share of + N，it须清楚回指。
nine-25.example: If a community business succeeds, local workers should receive a substantial share of its benefits.

nine-26.usage: 比较同类对象；A appears + 形容词 + when compared with B，被动省略逻辑主语清楚。
nine-26.example: Online courses may appear inexpensive when compared with residential programmes.

nine-26.usage: 数量稀少；复数人或物 + be few in number，区别the number is small。
nine-26.example: Qualified interpreters may be few in number in remote hospitals.

nine-26.usage: 取得突破；make breakthroughs in + 领域，不能只写breakthrough当动词。
nine-26.example: Long-term investment can help engineers make breakthroughs in energy storage.

nine-26.usage: 说明粮食保障结果；improve + food security，也可分词补充前述行动结果。
nine-26.example: Better rural roads could reduce delivery losses, improving food security in isolated communities.

nine-26.phrase: on the basis of their social contribution
nine-26.usage: 明确评价依据；on the basis of + N，不与市场形成机制混为一谈。
nine-26.example: Community grants could be assessed on the basis of their social contribution.

five-a1.usage: 说明能力可能性：one’s artistic potential；potential表潜能通常不可数。
five-a1.example: Schools can develop children’s scientific potential through practical experiments.

five-a1.usage: 定义表达渠道：a channel for + 人 + to V，或for + N/V-ing。
five-a1.example: Community meetings provide a channel for residents to discuss transport problems.

five-a1.usage: 说明入门容易：a low barrier to entry；to是介词，entry为名词。
five-a1.example: Free coding tools create a low barrier to entry for students with limited resources.

five-a1.phrase: a high level of technical skill
five-a1.usage: 评价能力：a high level of + N；skill此处为能力总称。
five-a1.example: Repairing medical equipment requires a high level of technical skill.

five-a1.usage: 说明技能形成条件：undergo/receive + extensive training，training不可数。
five-a1.example: Rescue workers need extensive training before attempting difficult operations.

five-a1.usage: 说明获得社会认可：work/achievement + gain(s) wide recognition。
five-a1.example: A successful community recycling project may gain wide recognition.

five-a2.usage: 说明提供表达可能：allow for + N；区别allow sb to V。
five-a2.example: Drama clubs allow for self-expression without requiring students to compete for grades.

five-a2.usage: 写认知收益：gain a better understanding of + N/V-ing。
five-a2.example: Studying abroad can help learners gain a better understanding of other cultures.

five-a2.usage: 说明整体特色：the distinctive character of + 地方/时期。
five-a2.example: Local markets contribute to the distinctive character of a neighbourhood.

five-a2.usage: 写切实改善：make tangible improvements in + 领域；正文为V-ing形式。
five-a2.example: Reliable buses can make tangible improvements in rural residents’ daily lives.

five-a2.usage: 说明产品外观与实用设计：industrial design；可作主语或介词宾语。
five-a2.example: Industrial design can make household appliances easier for older people to use.

five-a2.usage: 说明补充而非替代：complement + N，不加with才接直接宾语。
five-a2.example: Accounts from local residents can complement scientific knowledge of environmental change.

five-a3.usage: 表达经费投入：investment in + 领域；避免art construction。
five-a3.example: Investment in public transport can reduce dependence on private cars.

five-a3.usage: 说明资金去向：funds be allocated to + N/V-ing；to为介词。
five-a3.example: Additional resources could be allocated to supporting students with disabilities.

five-a3.usage: 说明心理收益：maintain + mental well-being；正文作V-ing并列成分。
five-a3.example: Regular contact with friends can help people maintain mental well-being.

five-a3.usage: 说明文化呈现作用：reflect + N；shared作定语。
five-a3.example: Community celebrations can reflect shared values while welcoming newcomers.

five-a3.usage: 比较追加收益：the principle of + N；须补需求已较满足等条件。
five-a3.example: The principle of diminishing returns may become relevant once basic classroom equipment is adequate.

five-a3.usage: 说明资源保留的具体价值：opportunities for + N/V-ing。
five-a3.example: Public libraries offer opportunities for independent learning to residents of all ages.

five-b1.usage: 说明预算转向：money be channelled into + N/V-ing。
five-b1.example: More funding could be channelled into improving bus reliability.

five-b1.usage: 指出受益群体：群体所有格 + well-being；不是泛指everyone。
five-b1.example: Affordable childcare can improve working parents’ well-being.

five-b1.usage: 写具体改善措施：the removal of + 障碍名词。
five-b1.example: The removal of unnecessary paperwork can shorten the application process.

five-b1.usage: 说明遗产对身份的意义：preserve/recognize + cultural identity。
five-b1.example: Language teaching can help young people understand their cultural identity.

five-b1.usage: 说明利用优势：capitalize on + N + to V；on不能省。
five-b1.example: A rural school could attract visitors by capitalizing on its access to local wildlife.

five-b1.phrase: according to a strict set of criteria
five-b1.usage: 说明决策依据：according to + N；criterion复数criteria。
five-b1.example: Scholarships should be awarded according to a clear set of criteria.

five-b2.usage: 检验能否负担实施：be financially viable；不同于effective。
five-b2.example: A free meal programme may be financially viable if local suppliers offer stable prices.

five-b2.usage: 描述缺少活动的生活方式：a sedentary lifestyle；lifestyle可数。
five-b2.example: Remote workers may develop a sedentary lifestyle unless they plan regular activity.

five-b2.usage: 揭示持续成本：ongoing + maintenance costs；costs复数列支出。
five-b2.example: Digital learning platforms also involve ongoing maintenance costs.

five-b2.usage: 解释行为障碍：discourage + sb + from + V-ing。
five-b2.example: High fares may discourage families from visiting museums regularly.

five-b2.usage: 提出针对时间障碍的措施：make time for + N/V-ing。
five-b2.example: Students can protect their health by making time for exercise during examination periods.

five-b2.usage: 说明问题值得重视：问题N + warrant(s) attention，不接to。
five-b2.example: The loss of local languages warrants attention because it can weaken cultural continuity.

five-b3.phrase: on the periphery of the city
five-b3.usage: 定位外围地区：on the periphery of + 地方。
five-b3.example: Wildlife on the periphery of the city may lose habitat when new roads are built.

five-b3.usage: 说明时间收益：spend + 时间 + V-ing，不写on + 动词原形。
five-b3.example: Online appointments allow patients to spend less time travelling to routine consultations.

five-b3.usage: 限制效果判断：措施 + may have limited effects；不等于完全无效。
five-b3.example: Lower tuition fees may have limited effects if students still cannot afford accommodation.

five-b3.usage: 写广泛长远影响：政策N + have far-reaching effects；需具体解释影响。
five-b3.example: Changes to teacher training can have far-reaching effects on classroom practice.

five-b3.usage: 列出多项之一：主句提到复数项目，the first being + N，独立主格。
five-b3.example: Two barriers prevent enrolment, the first being the cost of transport.

five-b3.usage: 比较避免损失：without + V-ing + 宾语。
five-b3.example: Digital services can improve access without sacrificing opportunities for face-to-face support.

five-b4.usage: 引出论证前提：justification + resides in the belief that + 完整从句。
five-b4.example: The case for later school starts resides in the belief that rested students learn more effectively.

five-b4.phrase: giving rise to physical health problems
five-b4.usage: 说明不良后果：give rise to + N；to为介词。
five-b4.example: Unreliable transport can give rise to difficulties for workers on early shifts.

five-b4.usage: 区分存在与真正可用：become/be available and accessible to + 人群。
five-b4.example: Learning materials should be available and accessible to students with visual impairments.

five-b4.usage: 说明互动的社会收益：build a sense of + N。
five-b4.example: Shared gardening projects can build a sense of community among residents.

five-b4.usage: 说明具体保护作用：provide shelter from + 风险/天气。
five-b4.example: Covered bus stops provide shelter from bad weather for elderly passengers.

five-b4.usage: 以需求为规划依据：in accordance with + N；正文needs补足指代。
five-b4.example: Training should be provided in accordance with the needs of each department.

five-t1.phrase: gain a better understanding of the world
five-t1.usage: 说明认知收益：gain a better understanding of + N。
five-t1.example: Field trips can help children gain a better understanding of local agriculture.

five-t1.usage: 说明系统学习：acquire + knowledge + systematically；knowledge不可数。
five-t1.example: A structured apprenticeship helps trainees acquire knowledge systematically.

five-t1.phrase: impart the knowledge gradually, effectively, and systematically
five-t1.usage: 说明教师传授方式：impart knowledge to + sb；三副词结构并列。
five-t1.example: Mentors can impart practical knowledge gradually and systematically to new employees.

five-t1.usage: 说明行为风险：lead + a/an + 形容词 + lifestyle。
five-t1.example: Long hours of online work may encourage adults to lead a sedentary lifestyle.

five-t1.usage: 提出平衡：seek a compromise between + A + and + B；两项形式平行。
five-t1.example: Cities must seek a compromise between visitor access and habitat protection.

five-t1.usage: 限制行为程度：act with moderation；with + 抽象名词。
five-t1.example: Consumers can enjoy convenience foods while acting with moderation.

five-t2.usage: 表达不得不妥协：have to + V；compromise with sb on/over + N。
five-t2.example: Shared housing can involve having to compromise with others over quiet hours.

five-t2.phrase: depending on their mood and preferences
five-t2.usage: 说明选择依据：depending on + N；介词on不可省。
five-t2.example: Learners can select an optional module depending on their interests and career plans.

five-t2.usage: 说明互动渠道：social contact通常不可数，communication表交流不可数。
five-t2.example: Community centres provide opportunities for social contact and communication.

five-t2.phrase: forge and strengthen bonds with others
five-t2.usage: 说明关系形成与加深：forge/strengthen bonds with + 人。
five-t2.example: Team projects can help students forge and strengthen bonds with others.

five-t2.usage: 说明满足社交需求：meet + 所有格 + needs。
five-t2.example: Older residents may meet their social needs through regular community activities.

five-t2.usage: 回应权衡：benefits + outweigh + drawbacks，不加than。
five-t2.example: The flexibility of online study may outweigh this disadvantage when reliable support is available.

five-t3.usage: 表达不利影响：be detrimental to + N；to为介词。
five-t3.example: Unpredictable schedules can be detrimental to family life.

five-t3.usage: 说明促进作用：act as a catalyst for + N/V-ing；a不可漏。
five-t3.example: Affordable childcare can act as a catalyst for greater workforce participation.

five-t3.phrase: predispose some children to aggressive behaviour
five-t3.usage: 表达倾向而非必然：predispose + sb + to + N/V-ing；some和may限制人群强度。
five-t3.example: Repeated setbacks may predispose some learners to avoiding difficult tasks.

five-t3.phrase: as a means of imparting knowledge
five-t3.usage: 表达教学工具：as a means of + V-ing；means单复数同形。
five-t3.example: Museums can use interactive exhibits as a means of imparting knowledge.

five-t3.usage: 说明辨别能力：distinguish + A + from + B。
five-t3.example: Media lessons can help teenagers distinguish advertising claims from reliable evidence.

five-t3.usage: 让后果具体化：the possible consequences of + N/V-ing。
five-t3.example: Applicants should consider the possible consequences of accepting an unpaid placement.

five-c1.usage: 说明高度重视：place a premium on + N/V-ing。
five-c1.example: Schools should place a premium on feedback that students can understand.

five-c1.usage: 说明分配相称：be in proportion to + N；be不可漏。
five-c1.example: Training support should be in proportion to the difficulties employees face.

five-c1.usage: 说明评价基础：assess/decide + on the basis of + N。
five-c1.example: Students should be assessed on the basis of their own work.

five-c1.usage: 说明评价维度：be assessed in terms of + N。
five-c1.example: Transport projects should be assessed in terms of reliability as well as speed.

five-c1.usage: 区分责任与外部因素：factors beyond + 所有格 + control。
five-c1.example: Farmers may suffer losses because of factors beyond their control.

five-c1.usage: 限制必然推论：主体 + by no means guarantee(s) + N。
five-c1.example: Expensive equipment can improve a laboratory but can by no means guarantee success.

five-c2.usage: 说明假期时长：数词 + weeks of annual leave；leave不可数。
five-c2.example: A longer period of paid study leave may help nurses complete advanced training.

five-c2.usage: 解释恢复机制：rest and recharge (oneself)；反身代词与主语一致。
five-c2.example: A quiet lunch area gives students a chance to rest and recharge themselves.

five-c2.usage: 写压力原因：give rise to + N，to为介词。
five-c2.example: Unclear examination instructions can give rise to stress.

five-c2.usage: 写最终行为后果：end up + V-ing，不接to V。
five-c2.example: Students who receive no support may end up abandoning their courses.

five-c2.usage: 提出提前替代安排：arrange cover；in advance作时间状语。
five-c2.example: Hospitals can arrange cover in advance when staff attend training courses.

five-c2.phrase: provided that staffing and scheduling are properly managed
five-c2.usage: 把可行性条件写明：provided that + 完整从句。
five-c2.example: Flexible classes can improve access, provided that timetables are properly coordinated.

five-c3.phrase: in the interests of society as a whole
five-c3.usage: 说明整体利益：in the interests of + 群体，不用interest单数表达此义。
five-c3.example: Transport planning should operate in the interests of society as a whole.

five-c3.usage: 写成功依赖的机制：rest on + N/V-ing；此处providing是V-ing。
five-c3.example: The success of online learning rests on providing reliable feedback.

five-c3.usage: 说明报酬相称：in proportion to + N。
five-c3.example: Scholarship support need not be in proportion to family income if the goal is equal access.

five-c3.phrase: taking a toll on the environment
five-c3.usage: 说明损害：take a toll on + N，常含累积负面影响。
five-c3.example: Repeated overnight work may take a toll on employees’ health.

five-c3.usage: 说明责任经营回报：earn + 人群所有格/名词修饰语 + trust。
five-c3.example: Clear assessment criteria can help schools earn parents’ trust.

five-c3.usage: 写社会与机构相互支持：support + N；须解释中间机制。
five-c3.example: Reliable public transport can support business success by helping employees arrive on time.

five-r1.usage: 说明个人心理收益：a sense of + N；deep强化程度。
five-r1.example: Completing a difficult project can give learners a deep sense of satisfaction.

five-r1.usage: 写能力收益：develop/improve + interpersonal skills，通常复数。
five-r1.example: Group laboratory work can help students develop interpersonal skills.

five-r1.phrase: make community work mandatory for all
five-r1.usage: 说明政策强度：make + N + mandatory for + 人群。
five-r1.example: Making online registration mandatory for all may exclude residents without reliable internet.

five-r1.usage: 区分道德责任与法律要求：a moral obligation to V。
five-r1.example: Schools have a moral obligation to provide accessible learning materials.

five-r1.phrase: A better option would be to
five-r1.usage: 提出替代措施：a better option would be to + V。
five-r1.example: A better option would be to provide reliable buses before increasing parking charges.

five-r1.usage: 表示自愿：of + 所有格 + own volition；不是out of。
five-r1.example: Students should be able to join debate clubs of their own volition.

five-r2.usage: 说明职业起步：embark on + N；on不可漏。
five-r2.example: Cities may embark on ambitious recycling programmes when waste collection systems are reliable.

five-r2.usage: 说明社会重视：第三人称主语 + places a premium on + N。
five-r2.example: An effective school places a premium on inclusive teaching.

five-r2.usage: 描述技能外流：brain drain；避免与所有migration等同。
five-r2.example: A region may experience brain drain when skilled workers lack career opportunities.

five-r2.usage: 解释流动动因：bleak + career prospects；prospects通常复数。
five-r2.example: Young people facing bleak career prospects may seek further training.

five-r2.usage: 批评不分情形的强制：a blanket + legal requirement/restriction。
five-r2.example: A blanket legal requirement to use digital services could disadvantage older residents.

five-r2.phrase: entice skilled professionals to stay or return
five-r2.usage: 说明激励方向：entice + sb + to V；不能把流出作为留才目的。
five-r2.example: Flexible schedules may entice experienced teachers to return to the classroom.

five-r3.usage: 明确全面禁止力度：a blanket ban on + N/V-ing。
five-r3.example: A blanket ban on all mobile devices may remove useful learning tools.

five-r3.usage: 说明风险程度：a high level of + risk；需给具体风险。
five-r3.example: Working without protective equipment can involve a high level of risk.

five-r3.usage: 说明保护责任：safeguard + N；正文为V-ing。
five-r3.example: Housing standards can play a role in safeguarding tenants’ well-being.

five-r3.phrase: provided that the ban was effectively enforced
five-r3.usage: 交代效果依赖执行：provided that + 完整从句；enforce是执行。
five-r3.example: Parking restrictions could reduce congestion, provided that they were consistently enforced.

five-r3.phrase: allowing informed choices despite some risk
five-r3.usage: 提炼有条件原则：allow + N；despite + N。
five-r3.example: Patient education can support informed choices despite some uncertainty.

five-r3.usage: 提出能力门槛：meet + minimum training requirements。
five-r3.example: Laboratory assistants should meet minimum training requirements before handling hazardous substances.
